meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: Claude收到写内部通讯的请求后，会先判断是哪类内容（如3P更新、公司通讯、FAQ等），加载技能内置的对应指南文件，严格按公司示例格式起草。若类型匹配不上，会向你追问澄清。
howto.when: 当用户要求写内部通讯时触发，例如状态报告、3P更新、公司通讯等。

say.text: 把本周的工作进展按公司格式写成一份3P更新。
按公司模板写一篇本周的全员通讯稿。
say.note: 加载公司通讯示例文件起草。

say.text: 起草FAQ中关于报销流程的回复。

howto.what_en: When asked to write internal communications, Claude identifies the type (e.g., 3P update, newsletter, FAQ), loads the matching guideline file from the skill's examples, and drafts content following the company-style format. If no guideline matches, it asks for clarification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for internal communications, e.g., status reports, 3P updates, company newsletters, etc.

say_en.text: Write a 3P update for this week's progress using our company format.
Draft a company-wide newsletter in our standard template.
Draft answers for common FAQ questions about expense reimbursement.
